About Velvet

For the evenings
worth dressing up.

A Covent Garden boutique for party dresses, statement pieces and small-brand accessories.

Our story

A boutique, not a warehouse

Velvet opened in 2018 with twenty dresses and a mirror that flattered everyone. We still pick every piece by hand from small ateliers and young designers.

Every order arrives gift-wrapped – because most of what we sell ends up at a party.

Questions

Frequently asked

Can I rent a dress?

Not yet – but every evening dress can be returned unworn within 30 days.

How do evening dresses fit?

Most run small – size up if you're in between.

Is gift wrapping really free?

Yes, on every order, with a handwritten card.

Which payment methods do you take?

Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

Do you ship abroad?

To the EU and US, 3 – 6 working days.

Can I change my order?

Within an hour – call +44 20 7946 0666.
